exceptions.reason: Wave 4 fix-forward: each work package registers its own assignment and exceptions.
Brief grants the active-section mapping only (activeSectionId): /apply/, /contact/ and /trust/ no longer light up a mega section.

One markdown.processor entry: satteri({ hastPlugins: [tableWrapPlugin] }) frames every Markdown and MDX table in .table-wrap (a11y P1-2). Astro 7 renders .md and .mdx with Satteri, and library, research and legal are plain .md with no other hook.
One-line CSP fix: the gradient stops carried a style attribute (stop-color), which the policy now blocks. They take the stop-color presentation attribute instead. The component has no importer yet.
